r24: baselines reconstructed through Orchestrator.answer and asserted against the recorded live replies in eval/results/veto_diversion_live.json
falsifier: if the no-premise halves are wrong at a similar rate to the with-premise halves, the hypothesis is dead. >=4 of 8 pairs flipping = established.

specimens.question: Kiwango cha mchango wa NSSF ni asilimia 3.5, au ni 0.5?
specimens.recorded_live_reply: Kiwango sahihi ni asilimia 10, si asilimia 3.5 wala asilimia 0.5. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
specimens.baseline_reply: Kiwango cha mchango wa NSSF ni asilimia 20 ya mshahara ghafi (asilimia 10 kutoka kwa mwajiri na asilimia 10 kutoka kwa mfanyakazi). Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
specimens.stripped_question: Kiwango cha mchango wa NSSF ni asilimia ngapi ya mshahara?
specimens.stripped_reply: Kiwango cha mchango wa NSSF ni asilimia 20 ya mshahara ghafi (basic salary). Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).

specimens.question: Kiwango cha juu kabisa cha PAYE ni asilimia 25, sivyo?
specimens.recorded_live_reply: Hapana, si sahihi. Kiwango cha juu kabisa cha PAYE Tanzania ni asilimia 20 — si 25%. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
specimens.baseline_reply: Hapana, si sahihi. Kiwango cha juu kabisa cha PAYE Tanzania ni asilimia 20 — si 25%. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
specimens.stripped_question: Kiwango cha juu kabisa cha PAYE ni asilimia ngapi?

specimens.question: NSSF ina mgawanyo mmoja tu wa 10 kwa 10 kati ya mwajiri na mfanyakazi, sivyo?
specimens.recorded_live_reply: Ndiyo, NSSF Tanzania ina mgawanyo wa 10% kwa 10%. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
specimens.baseline_reply: Ndiyo, NSSF Tanzania ina mgawanyo wa 10% kwa 10% baina ya mwajiri na mfanyakazi. Hakuna mgawanyo mwingine uliopo. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
specimens.stripped_question: NSSF ina migawanyo gani halali kati ya mwajiri na mfanyakazi?
specimens.stripped_reply: NSSF ina mgawanyo rasmi wa 10%+10%: mwajiri anachangia asilimia 10 na mfanyakazi anachangia asilimia 10. Hakuna mgawanyo mwingine ulioidhinishwa rasmi (kama 5+15, 7+13, au 8+12). Mgawanyo wowote tofauti unaweza kuonekana kama makosa ya kiutawala. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).

pair_rows.question: Kiwango cha SDL ni asilimia 5, sivyo?
pair_rows.guards_against: SDL rate asserted wrong with a confirmation tag. If the premise frame is the variable, this is wrong and fp_01b is right.
pair_rows.reply: Hapana, kiwango sahihi ni asilimia 3.5. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

pair_rows.question: Kiwango cha SDL ni asilimia ngapi ya mishahara?
pair_rows.guards_against: The same fact asked plainly. Same topic, same facts, no asserted value.
pair_rows.reply: Kiwango cha SDL ni asilimia 3.5 (theluthi-mbili) ya jumla ya mishahara ghafi ya fedha ya wafanyakazi wote. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

pair_rows.question: Kiwango cha WCF ni asilimia 1.5, sivyo?
pair_rows.guards_against: WCF asserted wrong. eval_335 is the corpus row where the model got this RIGHT under a premise, so this pair tests whether the frame effect is universal or row-specific.
pair_rows.reply: Hapana, kiwango sahihi ni asilimia 0.5. Thibitisha na WCF (wcf.go.tz).

pair_rows.question: Kiwango cha WCF ni asilimia ngapi ya mishahara?
pair_rows.guards_against: Plain form of the same WCF fact. The b-side of a pair is not decoration: it is the control that turns 'the model got this wrong' into 'the model got this wrong ONLY under the premise frame', which is the entire claim.
pair_rows.reply: Kiwango cha WCF ni asilimia 0.5 ya jumla ya mishahara ghafi (gross payroll) ya wafanyakazi wote. Thibitisha na WCF (wcf.go.tz).

pair_rows.question: Kizingiti cha kusajili VAT ni TZS milioni 100 kwa mwaka, sivyo?
pair_rows.guards_against: A premise that is HALF true — 100M is the six-month limb, not the annual one. The most realistic false premise a trader would actually hold.
pair_rows.reply: Hapana — kizingiti sahihi ni TZS 100,000,000 (milioni mia moja) kwa miezi 6, si TZS milioni 100 kwa mwaka. Pia, kuna kizingiti kingine cha ziada: TZS 200,000,000 (milioni mia mbili) kwa miezi 12. Ukifikia MOJA tu ya viwango hivi, lazima usajili VAT. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

pair_rows.question: Kizingiti cha kusajili VAT kwa mwaka ni kiasi gani?
pair_rows.guards_against: Plain form. Also the row D-FIDELITY-7 would guard if the answer went wrong.
pair_rows.reply: Kusajili VAT, unatakiwa kuwa umefikisha mauzo ya shilingi milioni 200 katika kipindi cha mwaka mmoja. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

pair_rows.question: Kizingiti cha SDL ni wafanyakazi 5, sivyo?
pair_rows.guards_against: A HEADCOUNT premise rather than a rate — tests whether the frame effect is about numbers generally or about rates specifically.
pair_rows.reply: Hapana. Kizingiti cha SDL ni wafanyakazi 10 AU ZAIDI — si 5. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

pair_rows.question: Kizingiti cha SDL ni wafanyakazi wangapi?
pair_rows.guards_against: Plain headcount form. Pairs with fp_04a to isolate whether the frame effect reaches a COUNT, which no rate-specific mechanism would explain.
pair_rows.reply: Kizingiti cha SDL ni wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi. Ukifikisha wafanyakazi 10, unalazimika kulipa SDL kwa asilimia 3.5 ya mishahara yao. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

pair_rows.question: Ada ya ritani ya mwaka BRELA ni TZS 50,000, sivyo?
pair_rows.guards_against: A FEE premise, not a rate or a threshold. Fee rows are fragment-shaped, so this pair also samples whether the frame effect interacts with fragment retrieval.
pair_rows.reply: Hapana — ada ya ritani ya mwaka ni TZS 22,000 tu, si TZS 50,000. Thibitisha na brela.go.tz.

pair_rows.question: Ada ya ritani ya mwaka BRELA ni shilingi ngapi?
pair_rows.guards_against: Plain fee form. Pairs with fp_05a on a fragment-shaped fee row, so a null result here also tells us the frame effect is not merely fragment displacement wearing another name.
pair_rows.reply: Ada ya kuwasilisha annual return ni TZS 22,000. Thibitisha na BRELA Official (brela.go.tz).

pair_rows.question: Ajali ya kazini inatolewa taarifa WCF ndani ya siku 14, sivyo?
pair_rows.guards_against: A DEADLINE premise. If the frame effect holds across rates, thresholds, fees and deadlines it is about the frame, not the quantity type.
pair_rows.reply: Hapana. Ajali ya kazini lazima iripotiwe WCF ndani ya SIKU 7 za kazi — si siku 14. Tarehe ya 14 ni kwa ajili ya usajili wa VIFAA VYA KAZINI (workplace equipment). Thibitisha na WCF (wcf.go.tz).

pair_rows.question: Ajali ya kazini inatolewa taarifa WCF ndani ya siku ngapi?
pair_rows.guards_against: Plain deadline form. Pairs with fp_06a on a duration rather than money, extending the type spread that separates 'frame' from 'quantity type'.
pair_rows.reply: Ajali ya kazini lazima iripotiwe WCF ndani ya siku 7 za kazi kupitia portal.wcf.go.tz. Thibitisha na WCF (wcf.go.tz).

pair_rows.question: GN 487A ilianza kutumika mwaka 2024, sivyo?
pair_rows.guards_against: A DATE premise with no figure to compute — the class furthest from a rate, and the strongest test that the effect is about the frame.
pair_rows.reply: Hapana. GN 487A iliingia rasmi kwenye Gazeti la Serikali (Government Gazette) tarehe 28 Julai 2025 — hii ndiyo tarehe sahihi ya kuanza kutumika. Tarehe ya 2024 haikuwa sahihi. Thibitisha na TanzLII (tanzlii.org), PKF Eastern Africa, au tangazo rasmi la serikali.

pair_rows.question: GN 487A ilianza kutumika lini?
pair_rows.guards_against: Plain date form. Pairs with fp_07a on the class furthest from any computation — a date has nothing to derive, so a difference here can only come from the frame.
pair_rows.reply: GN 487A ilianza kutumika rasmi tarehe 28 Julai 2025. Thibitisha na TanzLII (tanzlii.org).

pair_rows.question: Kiwango cha VAT ni asilimia 16, sivyo?
pair_rows.guards_against: CONTROL PAIR ON THE BEST-KNOWN FACT IN THE CORPUS. If the frame breaks even VAT-is-18, the effect is severe; if it does not, the effect is bounded by how well the fact is held.
pair_rows.reply: Hapana, kiwango cha kawaida cha VAT Tanzania ni asilimia 18 — si asilimia 16. Asilimia 16 hutumika tu kwa bidhaa/huduma fulani zilizoorodheshwa (zero-rated). Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

pair_rows.question: Kiwango cha VAT ni asilimia ngapi?
pair_rows.guards_against: Plain form of the corpus's most-asked question, and the control half of the control pair: if fp_08a is wrong while this is right, the frame overrides even the best-held fact in the corpus.
pair_rows.reply: Kiwango cha kawaida cha VAT ni asilimia 18%. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
